steps: Pressure cook the potato, cauliflower, carrot and peas with a little water until very soft, then mash them.
Melt half the butter in a wide pan and fry most of the onion until soft.
Add the crushed ginger, garlic and green chilli and fry for a minute.
Add the capsicum, then the tomato and salt, and cook until the tomato turns mushy.
Stir in the turmeric, chilli powder and most of the pav bhaji masala and fry for 2 minutes.
Add the mashed vegetables with a splash of water, mash again and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes until thick.
Slit the pav and toast it on a hot pan in a little butter with a pinch of pav bhaji masala.
Serve the bhaji with a knob of butter, raw onion, coriander and lemon, with the pav on the side.
note: Butter is 20 g a plate across cooking, toasting and topping, a little less than the street-style sources. Pav is listed as an ingredient at two rolls a plate because it has to be bought fresh on the day.
